LanguageData.RimGamble.BigEventMtb: Mean Time Between Ricky Risk Events
LanguageData.RimGamble.EnableTravelingGamblerTooltip: If disabled, traveling gamblers will never visit your colony.
LanguageData.RimGamble.AllowGamblerViolenceTooltip: Gamblers may become hostile if deals go badly.
LanguageData.RimGamble.AllowGamblerTheftTooltip: Gamblers may steal items when leaving.
LanguageData.RimGamble.ShowGamblerWarningsTooltip: Display warnings about potential negative outcomes in letters.
LanguageData.RimGamble.EnableAcceptanceBehaviorsToolt: Allow outcomes when the gambler is accepted into your colony.
LanguageData.RimGamble.AllowPeacefulDepartureTooltip: The gambler may simply leave peacefully after a few days.
LanguageData.RimGamble.AllowHumanBombTooltip: The gambler may explode, causing damage to your colony.
LanguageData.RimGamble.AllowSabotageTooltip: The gambler may sabotage your buildings before leaving.
LanguageData.RimGamble.AllowPartyMoodTooltip: The gambler may boost colonist moods by being the life of the party.
LanguageData.RimGamble.EnableAggressiveBehaviorsToolt: Allow violent and theft outcomes during gambling interactions.
LanguageData.RimGamble.AllowAssaultTooltip: The gambler may attack your colonists directly.
LanguageData.RimGamble.AllowRaidTooltip: The gambler may call in allies for an immediate raid.
LanguageData.RimGamble.AllowDelayedRaidTooltip: The gambler may organize a raid that arrives later.
LanguageData.RimGamble.AllowTheftTooltip: The gambler may steal valuable items from your colony.
LanguageData.RimGamble.EnableRejectionBehaviorsToolti: Allow outcomes when the gambler is rejected from your colony.
LanguageData.RimGamble.AllowPeacefulRejectionTooltip: The gambler may leave peacefully when rejected.
LanguageData.RimGamble.AllowAggressiveRejectionToolti: The gambler may become hostile when rejected.
